scope: Clean extracted source ZIP; fresh .venv; actual HTTP+backgroundworker; synthetic-only; no model API.

tasks.gravity-full: All six gravity QA checks: uniqueness, coverage, distribution, totals, reactions and evidence
tasks.gravity-distribution: Floor-by-floor gravity load assignment against independent area and intensity
tasks.load-combination: Recalculate numerical linear static combination responses from independent base responses
tasks.combination-configuration: Check required load combinations, cases and factors against an approved configuration
tasks.handoff: Compare ETABS source and SAFE target with an approved transfer manifest
tasks.seismic-configuration: Check explicitly supplied seismic settings against an approved checklist
tasks.mass-source: Check mass source settings against an approved checklist
tasks.additional-settings: Check other explicit model settings against an approved checklist

dependency_install: npm run setup:dev; pip check passed
final_package_verification: output/releases/release-verification.json (external receipt; avoids a self-referential ZIP hash)
